The transaction involves a debit amount of 9302.79 from account C1566511282 to C1973538135. Historical comparison with retrieved PaySim normal cases shows similar debit transaction amounts and balance decrease behavior, but similarity is contextual only and does not establish proof of fraud. No historical fraud cases, previous alerts, or previous investigations were retrieved from Cassandra. Regulatory guidelines from RBI emphasize real-time transaction monitoring and anomaly detection frameworks.
